mapper.insert: insert into stock_order (order_no, type, status, total_quantity, total_kinds, remark, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{orderNo}, #{type}, #{status}, #{totalQuantity}, #{totalKinds}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update stock_order set remark = #{remark}, total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, total_kinds = #{totalKinds}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} where id = #{id} and status = 0
update stock_order set status = 1, audit_time = now(), audit_user = #{userId}, update_time = now(), update_user = #{userId} where id = #{id} and status = 0
mapper.delete: delete from stock_order where id = #{id} and status = 0
mapper.select: select p.id as product_id, p.product_code, p.name as product_name, p.image, p.price, p.stock, s.id as sku_id, s.sku_code, s.attrs, s.price as sku_price, s.stock as sku_stock, s.status as sku_status from product_sku s join product p on p.id = s.product_id where s.sku_code = #{skuCode} limit 1
select id as product_id, product_code, name as product_name, image, price, stock from product where product_code = #{productCode} limit 1
select id as sku_id, sku_code, attrs, price, stock, status from product_sku where product_id = #{productId} order by id
